Module Contents

.. py:class:: LegacyQtObjectRenderer(parent: Optional[PySide6.QtWidgets.QWidget] = None)

   Bases: :py:obj:`picogl.ui.backend.qt.base.GLBase`


   Qt-based cube renderer using legacy OpenGL

   This class extends GLBase to provide a simple cube renderer with
   mouse controls for rotation and zoom.


   .. py:attribute:: _initialized
      :type:  bool
      :value: False
